entities.name: Hugh of Vermandois
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugh of Vermandois was the archbishop of Reims from 925 to 931 and from 940 to 946. He was the son of Herbert II, Count of Vermandois and Adela, the daughter of Robert I of France and sister of Hugh the Great.
